phase: 4.20 Agent B - phase 1 (survey + pipeline, no downloads)

recommended_dataset.name: StreetSurfaceVis V1.0
why: human labels (3 trained annotators, Krippendorff alpha 0.96 for type)
per-image latitude/longitude and contributor ids enable geographic and contributor-aware splits
official test split of five geographically distinct German cities (776 images)
limits: Germany only: no Italian evaluation possible
only 32 sett images in the official test split

download_proposal.disk_after_download_estimate: about 1.3 GB (zip read in place, not extracted; feature cache about 10 MB) of about 13 GB free
download_proposal.destination: session scratchpad data directory outside the repository

cheaper_alternative.name: s_256.zip
cheaper_alternative.caveat: focal crop only ~128x96 px; texture detail of sett joints largely lost

download_proposal.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); images by Mapillary contributors under CC BY-SA
download_proposal.attribution: StreetSurfaceVis V1.0 by Alexandra Kapp, Edith Hoffmann, Esther Weigmann and Helena Mihaljević (HTW Berlin, SurfaceAI), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.11449977, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; street-level images by the Mapillary contributors listed per image (user_name) in streetSurfaceVis_v1_0.csv, CC BY-SA 4.0. Paper: Kapp et al., Scientific Data 12, 92 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04295-9.
not_requested: any pretrained weights (SurfaceAI weights have no stated licence)

evaluation_design.test: official train=False split (five German cities, 776 images; sett 32, concrete 16)
evaluation_design.calibration: whole 0.5-degree cells chosen by salted hash order, >=20% of pool, >=10 images per class
evaluation_design.train: remaining cells, purged of test cells and of images within 2 km of calibration/test
diagnostics: shared cells/ids/min distance per split pair
contributor overlap and metrics on test images by contributors unseen in training
evaluation_design.primary_model: texture_hgb (HistGradientBoosting, fixed hyper-parameters, sigmoid-calibrated on calibration split)
evaluation_design.abstention: max-probability threshold chosen on calibration for accepted accuracy >= 0.90 (>=20 accepted)
evaluation_design.italy: not measurable with this dataset; requires a separate human-labelled Milan/Roccella set

criteria: sett recall >= 0.70 at argmax decision on test, with Wilson 95% lower bound reported
sett precision >= 0.70 at argmax decision on test, with Wilson 95% lower bound reported
macro-F1 of primary model exceeds colour-only baseline by >= 0.10
zero image-level and cell-level leakage between train, calibration and test
predeclared_phase2_criteria.evaluated_on: official StreetSurfaceVis test cities (train=False), never used for fitting, calibration or thresholds
predeclared_phase2_criteria.interpretation: Meeting all criteria only justifies an Italian human-labelled evaluation; it never justifies product integration.

local_availability.search: find for jpg/jpeg/png/webp/heic/tif under the repository, excluding node_modules, .git, dist, .next, .wrangler
local_availability.other: data/surfaces/milan-central.json has 33 OSM objects with mapillary=* (8 unique Mapillary image ids, all surface=asphalt); images are not on disk and contain no pave examples

coverage: GLCM counts vs textbook example and hand-computed properties
focal crop on PNG and JPEG (draft path)
confusion/precision/recall/F1/macro-F1, Brier, ECE, abstention threshold, Wilson, AP vs sklearn
split partition, zero leakage, test-cell purge, 2 km buffer purge, salt dependence, non-vacuous leakage detector
StreetSurfaceVis CSV+zip adapter, MD5/size verification, refusal of unapproved variants (offline)
end-to-end synthetic run: structure, byte-identical rerun, majority = prior, label-alignment check, shuffled-label negative control, feature cache

synthetic_smoke.label: SYNTHETIC_CODE_TEST_NOT_ACCURACY
synthetic_smoke.note: Synthetic classes are separable by construction; scores of 1.0 there only confirm plumbing and label alignment and must never be quoted as accuracy.

runtime.model_fit_estimate: seconds to a few minutes on CPU
runtime.maintenance: numpy/Pillow/scikit-learn only; no GPU, no torch

risks: Domain shift Germany -> Italy (porphyry/granite setts, fan patterns, tram rails, different cameras and light); no Italian ground truth
Viewpoint: Mapillary street-level vs a phone mounted in a car or on a handlebar; per-image labels vs per-way routing decisions
Class imbalance: only 32 sett and 16 concrete test images -> wide confidence intervals
Prevalence shift: dataset frequencies are curated, real precision will differ
Hand-crafted features are expected to fall well short of the published CNN (sett F1 0.90)
Licence: CC BY-SA share-alike may extend to weights/outputs; keep data and weights outside the MIT repo; never push predictions to OSM; ODbL mixing needs legal review
Mapillary terms: no de-blurring; any future Milan image collection needs an owner-held API token

provisional_decision.reason: Predeclared criteria not all met: sett precision 0.632 < 0.70 (Wilson lower bound 0.47) and ECE 0.113 > 0.10. Recall (0.75) and the gain over the colour baseline (+0.31 macro-F1) passed. Even a pass would only have justified an Italian human-labelled evaluation.
possible_future_work_requires_new_approv: Italian human-labelled evaluation set (Milan/Roccella) before any model choice
CNN fine-tuning would need torch plus pretrained weights with a clear licence (separate owner approval)

rules_not_followed: report.md (Italian) could not be written: the agent harness refuses report files from a subagent. The Italian interpretation is in the agent's final message.

phase2.data_location: session scratchpad data directory (zip read in place, never extracted, never in the repo)
phase2.independent_recomputation: primary sett P=24/38=0.6316, R=24/32=0.75 and macro-F1=0.6475 recomputed from the stored confusion matrix; match reported values
